title: Screenshot Parsing
description: Parses UI screenshots into structured layouts - regions, text, controls - with vision models. Parsing turns a picture of an interface into data a generator can work with.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Layout Detection
description: Detects the layout structure - grids, stacks, alignment - from parsed elements. Layout understanding separates intentional structure from coincidental positioning.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Component Mapping
description: Maps detected elements to real components in the design system - this rectangle is a Card, that is a PrimaryButton. Mapping grounds generation in the team's actual library.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Design-Token Extraction
description: Extracts colors, spacing, and typography as design tokens from the visual input. Tokens make generated code themeable instead of hardcoding pixel values.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Responsive Inference
description: Infers how the layout should adapt across screen sizes from a single design. Responsive inference turns one screenshot into a fully responsive implementation.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Accessibility Annotation
description: Annotates generated code with accessibility - labels, roles, focus order - inferred from the visual design. Annotation bakes in the a11y that generators otherwise forget.

title: Handwriting-to-Form
description: Converts photos of hand-drawn forms into working form code - fields, labels, validation. Handwriting input makes the napkin sketch executable.

title: Voice-Described UI
